title: Beam over the canoe, taken aboard, wand jabbed in Jim's ribs

tellings.quote: I remembered it being right over on like literally on top of us and it this beam came down around the canoe

plain: A man named Jim Weiner says that in August 1976, while canoeing on the Allagash Waterway in Maine, a craft hovered right on top of him and his companions and a beam of light came down around the canoe. He says they were taken aboard, and that a wand was jabbed into his ribs. If true, it would be a case of people being abducted by non-human beings.
